title: feat(mechanic): enrule that tests of .agent/repo=.this skills live collocated in the agent dir
description:
## .the rule

a test of a `.agent/repo=.this` skill lives collocated beside the skill, in the agent dir, at integration grain. never under `blackbox/`: blackbox acceptance tests the published contract, and a repo-local skill is no part of it.

## .the two hazards a move must cure

1. **a moved test drops out of every run, and no check turns red.** jest `testMatch` lists `'!**/.agent/**'`, so a moved suite is skipped by construction. narrow the exclusion so `.agent/repo=.this/**` is in, while `.agent/.cache`, `.agent/.actors`, and linked `repo=<other>` dirs stay out (a negation beats a positive glob, so a positive pattern alone does not work)
2. **a test file in `skills/` boots as a skill ref in every session.** a file in a skills dir that no glob matches boots as a ref; list `skills/*.test.ts` and `skills/__snapshots__/**` under `always.skills.not`

## .blocker

a test of a `.agent/repo=.this` skill under `blackbox/`.
